warden.name: Warden
warden.blurb: Shield and stubbornness. Hard to kill, hits like a falling door. Stuns enemies before their big attacks land.

ashblade.name: Ashblade
ashblade.blurb: A lamplighter who learned the fire can be thrown. Sets enemies burning, and makes the lantern's flare far stronger.

wayfarer.name: Wayfarer
wayfarer.blurb: Quick feet, a quicker knife. Bleeds enemies, dodges blows, and finishes wounded things in one cut.

bash.name: Shield Bash
bash.desc: A solid hit with a 45% chance to stun. Stunning cancels the enemy's next move.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.desc: Brace for 2 turns: take 60% less damage and hit back at anyone who strikes you.

rally.name: Rally
rally.desc: Heal 30% of your health and shake off every harmful effect.

judgement.name: Judgement
judgement.desc: A crushing blow. Far stronger against stunned or weakened enemies.

ember_strike.name: Ember Strike
ember_strike.desc: A burning blow driven by Will. Sets the target burning for 3 turns.

kindle.name: Kindle
kindle.desc: Feed the fire: your next fire skill or flare deals +40%, and your lantern regains 12 oil.

cinder_wall.name: Cinder Wall
cinder_wall.desc: A wall of embers that absorbs damage (Will x3) and burns whoever hits it.

immolate.name: Immolate
immolate.desc: Engulf every enemy. Consumes their burns to deal extra damage.

twin_cut.name: Twin Cut
twin_cut.desc: Two quick cuts, each with a 50% chance to cause bleeding.

shadowstep.name: Shadowstep
shadowstep.desc: Slip aside: dodge the next attack completely, and your next hit is a critical.

hamstring.name: Hamstring
hamstring.desc: Cripple the target: heavy bleeding and Weakness (they deal 35% less damage).

coup.name: Coup de Grace
coup.desc: A finishing strike. Devastating against enemies below 35% health.
